learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn to use 'Was' and 'Were' as helping verbs to talk about things that happened in the past (yesterday or before).]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Get in the Time Machine! ⏱️ Today is Is, Am, Are. But what about YESTERDAY? Yesterday I WAS playing, and my friends WERE eating cake. Let's learn the magic words of the Past!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🕰️ What are Was and Were? (था / थे)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Was and Were are helping verbs that we use to talk about the PAST. The past means something that has already happened, like yesterday or last year.
examples_or_templates: They were happy at the party. 🎉

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'Was' when we talk about ONE person, animal, or thing in the past. It holds hands with I, He, She, It, and Singular Nouns.
We use 'Were' when we talk about MANY people or things in the past. It holds hands with We, They, Plural Nouns, and the special word 'You'!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔄 Is/Am becomes Was, Are becomes Were
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Here is a secret trick! If a sentence uses 'Is' or 'Am' today, it will change to 'Was' for yesterday. If it uses 'Are' today, it changes to 'Were'!
examples_or_templates: Today: I am six. -> Last year: I was five. 🎂
Today: We are here. -> Yesterday: We were there. 🗺️

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which word will you use to talk about yesterday for 'I'?
❓ The birds ____ flying in the sky yesterday.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: She ____ my teacher last year.
✍️ Choose the correct word: You (was / were) my partner in the game.
subjective_practice.hint: Remember, the word 'You' always takes the plural helping verb!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: The boys ____ playing cricket yesterday.
subjective_practice.hint: Boys mean many. Which word do we use for many in the past? (were)

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 My 'Yesterday' Diary
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Think about what you did yesterday. Write three sentences starting with 'I was...' and read them to your parents! (Like: I was playing. I was happy.)

chapter_summary: ⭐ Was and Were tell us about the past (yesterday).
⭐ We use 'Was' with I, He, She, It, and Singular words.
⭐ We use 'Were' with We, You, They, and Plural words.
